status: DRAFT: priors, weights and loss fractions are hand-set approximations of published extension guidance, not transcribed tables. Pending agronomy review by Caleb. Citations name the publication family to verify.

sources.isu_hail: Iowa State Univ. Extension, corn and soybean hail damage guides (yield loss by stage and defoliation)
sources.purdue_water: Purdue Univ. Extension (R.L. Nielsen), corn water stress around silking and grain fill
sources.unl_irrig: Univ. of Nebraska-Lincoln Extension, center pivot irrigation scheduling and failure effects
sources.umn_n: Univ. of Minnesota / Iowa State Extension, corn nitrogen deficiency symptoms and loss
sources.cropprotection: Crop Protection Network (corn, soybean disease guides: tar spot, gray leaf spot, SDS)
sources.ipmpipe: Corn ipmPIPE / EDDMapS county disease reports
sources.ksu_drift: K-State / Univ. of Missouri Extension, herbicide drift symptoms and soybean/corn injury
sources.isu_stand: Iowa State Univ. Extension, corn and soybean planter skips, stand and yield
sources.isu_flood: Iowa State / Purdue Extension, flooding and ponding effects on corn and soybean
sources.nrcs_soil: USDA NRCS Soil Data Access / Web Soil Survey (sandy texture, available water capacity)
sources.noaa_mrms: NOAA MRMS MESH radar hail estimate; SPC storm reports
sources.rma: USDA RMA Loss Adjustment Standards Handbook / Crop Insurance Handbook
sources.nass: USDA NASS Crop Production and Quick Stats (state yield trend)
sources.analyzer: FieldWatch analyzer pattern features (docs/data-pipelines.md M3); weight set by hand
sources.farmer: Farmer's own report (farmer_reply); weight set by hand
sources.photo: Photo diagnosis by the imagery specialist; weight set by hand

stage_groups.early: planting to V5 (soy: VE to V3)
stage_groups.vegetative: V6 to pre-tassel (soy: V4 to before R1)
stage_groups.grain_fill: R3 to R5 (soy: R3 to R5)

pivot_failure.label: Pivot not watering
pivot_failure.prior_reason: Hand-set base rate for a flagged anomaly, to be tuned on real examples (docs/data-pipelines.md M4).

ring_pattern_strong.reason: A ring or arc at one radius matches a clogged or dead span (last-span path).

ring_pattern_weak.reason: A faint ring is weak support for a span problem.

wedge_pattern_strong.reason: A sector stress shape fits a stuck or leaking span or end-gun issue.

edge_pattern_strong.reason: Edge-band stress can be a pivot corner or end-of-run shortfall.

farmer_reports_pivot_down.reason: The farmer says the pivot was down or erroring.

farmer_reports_pivot_ok.reason: The farmer says the pivot ran normally and on schedule.

rain_deficit_30d.reason: A dry month raises reliance on the pivot, so a failure shows up sooner.

rain_normal_30d.reason: Normal rain masks a short pivot outage.

stress_uniform_field.reason: Whole-field uniform stress points away from a localized irrigation fault.

hail.label: Hail damage
hail.prior_reason: Hand-set base rate for a flagged anomaly, to be tuned on real examples (docs/data-pipelines.md M4).

hail_mesh_large.reason: Radar hail estimate at or above 25 mm over the field.

hail_mesh_moderate.reason: Radar hail estimate of 12-25 mm over part of the field.

no_hail_mesh.reason: Radar shows no hail over the field in the window.

hail_ground_report_near.reason: A storm report of hail within about 10 km.

hail_swath_overlap_high.reason: The stressed area lines up with the hail swath.

hail_swath_no_overlap.reason: The stressed area is outside the hail swath.

photo_leaf_shredding.reason: Photo shows torn, shredded leaves and bruised stalks.

sudden_drop_after_storm.reason: NDVI dropped sharply right after a storm date.

drought.label: Dry weather stress
drought.prior_reason: Hand-set base rate for a flagged anomaly, to be tuned on real examples (docs/data-pipelines.md M4).

rain_deficit_30d.reason: Rain over 30 days well below normal.

rain_normal_30d.reason: Rain over 30 days near or above normal.

drought_monitor_d1_plus.reason: County is D1 or worse on the Drought Monitor.

heat_days_over_35c.reason: Several days above 35 C add water demand.

stress_uniform_field.reason: Broad field-wide stress fits weather rather than a local fault.

pattern_localized.reason: Stress in a sharp local shape is less typical of drought alone.

ponding.label: Standing water / waterlogging
ponding.prior_reason: Hand-set base rate for a flagged anomaly, to be tuned on real examples (docs/data-pipelines.md M4).

lowspot_overlap_high.reason: The stressed area sits in the terrain low spots.

lowspot_overlap_none.reason: The stressed area is not in low spots.

heavy_rain_7d.reason: Heavy rain in the last week (about 50 mm or more).

rain_excess_30d.reason: Rain over 30 days well above normal.

soil_poorly_drained.reason: Soil map units are poorly or somewhat poorly drained.

soil_well_drained.reason: Soil map units are well drained.

photo_standing_water.reason: Photo shows standing water or yellowed drowned plants.

nitrogen.label: Nitrogen shortage
nitrogen.prior_reason: Hand-set base rate for a flagged anomaly, to be tuned on real examples (docs/data-pipelines.md M4).

rain_excess_30d.reason: Wet spells leach or denitrify nitrogen.

corn_after_corn.reason: Corn after corn needs more nitrogen and gets no rotation credit.

prior_crop_soybeans.reason: Soybean rotation credit lowers nitrogen need.

pattern_uniform_pale.reason: Field-wide pale green, worst on lower leaves.

ndre_low_ndvi_normal.reason: Red-edge index low while NDVI is still normal (chlorophyll first).

photo_v_shaped_firing.reason: Photo shows V-shaped yellowing from leaf tip on lower leaves.

farmer_reports_n_short.reason: The farmer applied less nitrogen than planned.

farmer_reports_n_full.reason: The farmer applied the full nitrogen rate on time.

sandy_soil_overlap_high.reason: Sandy zones lose nitrogen to leaching.

herbicide_drift.label: Herbicide drift
herbicide_drift.prior_reason: Hand-set base rate for a flagged anomaly, to be tuned on real examples (docs/data-pipelines.md M4).

edge_pattern_strong.reason: Injury concentrated on one field edge fits drift from a neighbor.

edge_pattern_none.reason: No edge concentration is less typical of drift.

photo_leaf_cupping.reason: Photo shows cupped, strapped or crinkled new leaves.

wind_during_spray_window.reason: Breezy spray-season days with a neighbor application.

farmer_reports_neighbor_spray.reason: The farmer knows a neighbor sprayed nearby.

planter_skip.label: Planter or equipment skips
planter_skip.prior_reason: Hand-set base rate for a flagged anomaly, to be tuned on real examples (docs/data-pipelines.md M4).

stripe_pattern_strong.reason: Straight parallel bands match planter row units or sprayer passes.

stripe_pattern_none.reason: No stripe geometry in the stressed area.

stripe_width_matches_implement.reason: Band spacing matches the planter or sprayer width.

photo_gaps_in_row.reason: Photo shows missing plants or doubles along the row.

farmer_reports_planter_issue.reason: The farmer remembers a planter or sprayer problem.

disease_pest.label: Disease or insects
disease_pest.prior_reason: Hand-set base rate for a flagged anomaly, to be tuned on real examples (docs/data-pipelines.md M4).

disease_confirmed_county.reason: Tar spot, gray leaf spot, SDS or similar confirmed in the county this season.

disease_history_county.reason: The county has a history of the disease in past seasons.

no_disease_reports_county.reason: No confirmed disease reports in the county this season.

humid_wet_weather_30d.reason: Warm, humid and wet weather favors foliar disease.

patchy_irregular_pattern.reason: Irregular patches fit disease or insect spread.

photo_tar_spot_lesions.reason: Photo shows raised black tar-spot stromata.

photo_gray_leaf_spot_lesions.reason: Photo shows rectangular gray lesions between veins.

photo_sds_symptoms.reason: Photo shows interveinal scorch and root or stem symptoms (soybean SDS).

photo_insect_feeding.reason: Photo shows insects or chewing damage.

photo_no_lesions.reason: Photo shows clean leaves without lesions or insects.

sandy_soil_water_stress.label: Sandy soil running short of water
sandy_soil_water_stress.prior_reason: Hand-set base rate for a flagged anomaly, to be tuned on real examples (docs/data-pipelines.md M4).

sandy_soil_overlap_high.reason: The stressed area sits on sandy, low-water-holding soil.

soil_not_sandy.reason: Soil is uniform loam or silt loam, not sand.

soil_low_awc.reason: Available water capacity is low in the top 100 cm.

rain_deficit_30d.reason: A dry month hits sandy soil first.

rain_normal_30d.reason: Normal rain keeps sandy soil from stressing.

unknown.label: Something else / not yet clear
unknown.prior_reason: Hand-set base rate for a flagged anomaly, to be tuned on real examples (docs/data-pipelines.md M4).

no_pattern_found.reason: No recognizable pattern in imagery or context.

clear_pattern_found.reason: A clear pattern exists that another condition explains.
